annotations.title: Write and send email to users

description: Writes email templates and campaigns, sets topics and events, sends a test to the team and starts or cancels a campaign. More: neblla_get_llms tools/mail

action.description: By action: delete_template {id}; set_campaign {id?, name, topic, segment?, defaultLang?, versions}; delete_campaign {id}; send_test {template | campaign, to, lang?}; send {id, confirm: true, sendAt?}; cancel {id}

confirm.description: Set true to run the irreversible action

segment.description: set_campaign: filter of up to 2 levels

sendAt.description: send: ISO date to schedule it (now if left out)

to.description: send_test: an address of the app's team

topic.description: set_campaign: the consent topic it goes to

name: neblla_mail
